response.original_title: Malayo Sa Bituka, Malapit Sa Puso
response.overview: When you’re the person everyone relies on, you can’t not show up. While studying in Manila to become a heart surgeon, an aspiring medical student returns home to Tuguegarao to seek closure with his distant childhood love—unaware that her cold goodbyes were a quiet sacrifice made to keep his dreams going.
response.tagline: FAR FROM THE GUT, YET CLOSE TO THE HEART.
response.title: Malayo Sa Bituka, Malapit Sa Puso
